name: new_horizons_land_taps_for_two_of_one_color
notes: M7 mapper. Printed: 'Enchant land. When this Aura enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Enchanted land has "{T}: Add two mana of any one color."' Seat 0 casts New Horizons on its Odd Desert (a land with no mana ability of its own); the enters trigger puts a +1/+1 counter on Your Bear. Then seat 0 activates the Desert's granted ability: the Desert taps and seat 0 adds two blue mana (one colour, chosen once).
